violation_type.title: Volunteers and contractors not counted in the child/caregiver ratio must comply with minimum standards that apply to employees (26 TAC §746.1401(b))
violation_type.short_title: Volunteers and contractors not counted in the child/caregiver ratio must comply with minimum standards that apply to employees
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. The operation had 14-year-old individuals interacting with the enrolled children in a caregiver capacity.

finding_variants.text: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. The operation had 14-year-old individuals interacting with the enrolled children in a caregiver capacity.
A contractor's file is missing the following information:    -Orientation Training Statement  -Statement regarding personnel and operational policies  -Notarized Affidavit
At the inspection, a volunteer was on a cell phone while caring for kids.
One volunteer was observed in the school age classroom with the present of children.
A substitute was observed caring for a group of childern. This was corrected when the primary group caregiver returned to the classroom.
